metadata.label: Ideathon decision model
metadata.disclaimer: Planning recommendations and intervention effects are transparent scenarios, not measured outcomes, official forecasts, or vendor quotations.

sources.label: OpenStreetMap
sources.use: Mapped roads, places and sensitive-site context

sources.label: CPCB National AQI
sources.use: Indian monitoring and AQI reference pathway

sensorSiting.title: Recommended first monitoring site
sensorSiting.description: Prioritizes a practical first sensor location using sensitive-site access, emission-source proximity, field access and the current monitoring gap.

candidates.name: Central Malegaon civic zone
candidates.reason: Best balance of public access, central coverage and proximity to schools, health facilities and mixed urban activity.

candidates.name: Eastern industrial edge
candidates.reason: Strong source-proximity signal, but a less balanced community-coverage and access profile.

candidates.name: Western traffic corridor
candidates.reason: Useful traffic exposure context with weaker city-wide representativeness than the central site.

candidates.name: Southern residential edge
candidates.reason: Closes a spatial gap but captures fewer mixed-source and sensitive-site conditions.

interventions.title: Pollution-reduction sandbox
interventions.description: Applies adjustable, illustrative reductions to the current modeled PM values so participants can compare interventions without claiming a forecast.

options.name: Traffic-idling control
options.description: Enforcement and routing near congested corridors during peak periods.

options.name: Industrial housekeeping
options.description: Dust control, stack-maintenance checks and cleaner fuel adoption support.

options.name: Open-burning response
options.description: Hotspot reporting, collection coordination and targeted enforcement.

feasibility.title: 12-week field pilot
feasibility.description: A phased first deployment that keeps the dashboard open-source and adds one calibrated field sensor at the recommended site.

phases.name: Validate
phases.description: Confirm permissions, candidate site and CPCB-compatible reference pathway.

phases.name: Deploy
phases.description: Install, co-locate for calibration and connect the observed-data contract.

phases.name: Evaluate
phases.description: Publish observed-versus-modeled MAE, RMSE and reliability evidence.

phases.name: Act
phases.description: Run one ward intervention and present a transparent before/after review.
